fixture_id_rule: FSR.FIXTURE.<sha256(generator-spec bytes + hidden-ledger bytes + exact source hashes)[0:24]>

clock_definitions.H1_PROVIDER_NATIVE: independent control built from complete hidden generator path before M1 gap omission; never repairs M1
clock_definitions.15M: derived only from 15 exact contiguous M1 records
clock_definitions.H1_M1_DERIVED: derived only from 60 exact contiguous M1 records
clock_definitions.2H_A_L: derived only from 120 exact contiguous M1 records

source_artifact_policy: Exact source CSVs are materialised by the governed generator into the FSR execution artifact; Git stores the generator, expected hashes and compact manifests rather than duplicating generated market-like tables.
expected_invariants: BID and ASK timestamp sets are identical
ASK OHLC is strictly above corresponding BID OHLC by deterministic positive spread
timestamps are strictly monotonic Unix milliseconds
M1 gap is explicit and never repaired by H1
15M/H1_M1_DERIVED/2H_A_L buckets crossing the gap are quarantined
first_valid_time is never earlier than source close/confirmation time
hidden construction labels are absent from pipeline inputs
same source+code+contracts produces identical hashes and record IDs
